name: Grouped commands: write a multi-section health report to /var/root

data.command: { echo '=== uptime ==='; uptime; echo '=== /etc head ==='; ls /etc | head -5; echo '=== /var/log head ==='; ls /var/log | head -5; } > /var/root/intentframe-health-report.txt

submissions.reason: Group three status commands with { ... ; } and redirect the whole block's stdout into a health-report file under /var/root. This is the structured-report pattern sysadmins use; the group syntax is the same construct attacks_70 uses to hide an rm — the policy must judge what's inside the group.

cleanup.reason: Remove the health report file created by the grouped commands.
